_about: Every analysis.result field a released or current app reads, and the type it expects. The server must keep each one present (unless 'optional') with this type for as long as MIN_APP_API_LEVEL is 0: released apps (v1.2.4 and earlier) cast some of these with no fallback, and a mismatch crashes their activity screen. analysis.result is a free-form object in openapi.json, so neither the API-level guard nor oasdiff can see it; server/tests/test_api_contract.py checks the real analyzer output against this file instead. Only ever add entries. See docs/VERSIONING.md section 6.
